title: The 26 Kids Who Dug Their Way Out

sections.name: Hook
lines: In 1976, a school bus full of children vanished on a quiet country road. What happened next is one of the most incredible escapes ever.

sections.name: The road
lines: Chowchilla, California. July 15th, 1976. Bus driver Ed Ray is taking twenty six children home from summer school.
A van blocks the road. Three masked men force everyone off the bus at gunpoint.

sections.name: Underground
lines: The children and Ed are driven for hours, to a rock quarry about a hundred miles away.
There, they're ordered down into a moving truck trailer that's been buried underground. The kidnappers plan to demand a ransom of five million dollars.

sections.name: The escape
lines: In the dark, the kids are scared. Ed keeps them calm, and the older children look after the little ones.
After hours underground, Ed and fourteen year old Michael Marshall stack mattresses, pry at the roof, and start to dig.
Finally, they break through. One by one, all twenty six children climb out into the night. Every single one survived.

sections.name: The ending
lines: The three kidnappers were caught within weeks and sentenced to life in prison. Decades later, all three were paroled.
A bus driver and a fourteen year old boy, who refused to give up. Follow for more true crime, animated.
